svg.aria-label: One group of PR Board, annotated. The heading names the category and its repositories, then a bar of its open PRs per colour, how many are open and how many merged. Each row has a left bar coloured by what the PR still needs and its number; the title comes first, without its category tag, with the repository, the branch it merges into and the signal chips under it; the next step is a chip on the right, solid when it is your move and outlined, on a faded row, when you wait. A PR that waits on another sits under it with an elbow and an after #412 label. Below, the bar colours, every signal chip with its meaning and every next-step chip, taken from the page's legend.
